value.name: Full Scholarship Scheme for International Olympiad Medalists (Bachelor of Science, École Polytechnique)

scholarship_exists.quote: FULL SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR INTERNATIONAL OLYMPIAD MEDALISTS Ecole Polytechnique is launching a new scholarship for International Olympiad medalists, to honor their outstanding achievements. It is offering a limited number of scholarships to medalists who are admitted to the Bachelor of Science Program
scholarship_exists.notes: Same page also lists the Excellence Scholarship (4,800 EUR per year for 3 years, students admitted with honors; no nationality condition stated) and need-based aid. This top-up names the Olympiad award because it is the one whose international eligibility the page states; the KB merge replaces the scholarship_exists question as a unit, so the Excellence fact is superseded once this draft is CI-verified. Eligibility: a medal in a listed international Olympiad in the two years before enrolment (gold medalists prioritised); cannot be combined with other Ecole Polytechnique / Foundation / French government aid; the 1,500 EUR annual administration fee is still due.

scholarship_international.quote: Maximum scholarship limit (tuition fees plus living allowance) is 87,900 Euros per non-EU/EEA student and 78,750 Euros per EU/EEA student.
scholarship_international.notes: The award sets its own cap for non-EU/EEA students, so international (non-EU/EEA) students are eligible. The need-based section adds: 'All other candidates, i.e. international, European and French students not entitled to the CROUS bursary , may benefit from need-based financial aid proposed directly by Ecole Polytechnique' (tuition fee waiver and/or interest-free loan).
